subject: Английский язык
authors: Вербицкая М. В., Эббс Б., Уорелл Э., Уорд Э.

chapters.title: Let's watch TV! Давай посмотрим телевизор!

problems.condition: Unit 14, упр. 1, с. 4. Послушай предложения и выучи названия телепрограмм.
steps: the news — новости, cartoons — мультфильмы, a film — фильм, a music programme — музыкальная программа, a sports programme — спортивная программа, a quiz — викторина.
problems.answer: news, cartoons, film, music programme, sports programme, quiz

problems.condition: Unit 14, упр. 2, с. 5. Прочитай слова по транскрипции и объясни значение.
steps: channel /ˈtʃænəl/ — канал, programme /ˈprəʊgræm/ — программа, cartoon /kɑːˈtuːn/ — мультфильм, television /ˈtelɪvɪʒn/ — телевидение, video /ˈvɪdɪəʊ/ — видео.

problems.condition: Unit 14, упр. 3, с. 5. Сколько каналов в программе? Обсуди передачи.
steps: There are two channels. What's on Channel 1 at six o'clock? — The film «Adventure in Space». What's on Channel 2 at half past five? — «Cartoon Time». What's on Channel 2 at six? — The news.

problems.condition: Unit 14, упр. 4, с. 5. Спроси друга, что он хочет посмотреть.
steps: What do you want to watch? — «Music for You». What time is it on? — Half past five. What do you want to watch? — The news. What time is it on? — Six o'clock.
problems.answer: What do you want to watch? What time is it on?

problems.condition: Unit 14, упр. 5, с. 6. Как читается сочетание wh?
steps: which, where, when, white, what, why — wh читается /w/; who, whose — /h/. Другие слова: wind, sandwich, winter, women, wonder, want.

problems.condition: Unit 14, упр. 6, с. 6. Прочитай предложения со звуками /w/ и /v/.
steps: I want to watch TV. Jill watches TV every day. Ben wants to watch a video. Vera likes videos very much.

problems.condition: Unit 14, упр. 7, с. 6. Задай по два вопроса к каждой картинке и ответь.
steps: Who is she? What does she want? — She is Sally. She wants to play the drums. Who is he? What does he want? — He is Cody. He wants to play the guitar. Who is she? — She is Miss Fisher. She wants to sing.
problems.answer: Who is …? What does … want? — He / She wants to …

problems.condition: Unit 14, упр. 8, с. 7. Послушай рассказ и покажи, о ком говорит Джилл.
steps: Sam, Clara, Running Deer, Dan, Silver.
problems.answer: Sam, Clara, Running Deer, Dan, Silver

problems.condition: Unit 14, упр. 9, с. 7. Ответь на вопросы.
steps: Dan is short and fat. He's the sheriff. Silver is brown and white. He's Dan's dog. Sam is tall and thin. He's a cowboy. Running Deer can ride a horse very well.
problems.answer: Dan — sheriff, Silver — dog, Sam — cowboy, Running Deer — rides a horse

problems.condition: Unit 14, упр. 10, с. 7. Послушай песню и посмотри на картинки.
steps: Песня о том, что стоит иногда остановиться и подумать о вещах, которые тебе нравятся.

problems.condition: Unit 14, упр. 11, с. 7. Что любит герой песни?
steps: He likes tea, cheese sandwiches, watching TV and reading.
problems.answer: tea, cheese sandwiches, watching TV, reading

problems.condition: Unit 14, упр. 12, с. 7. Расскажи другу, что тебе нравится.
steps: I like riding a horse. I like dancing. I like skating. I like watching cartoons.

chapters.title: At the fair! В парке аттракционов

problems.condition: Unit 15, упр. 1, с. 8. Послушай, посмотри на картинки и ответь на вопросы.
steps: Yes, I like fairs. I know the roller coaster and the ghost train.

problems.condition: Unit 15, упр. 2, с. 9. Послушай и покажи слова на картинке.
steps: A, E, F, C, D, B.
problems.answer: A, E, F, C, D, B

problems.condition: Unit 15, упр. 3, с. 9. Посмотри на картинки и ответь на вопросы.
steps: Ben wants to go on the dodgems. Sally wants to have some candy floss. Jill wants to go on the roller coaster. Cody wants to go on the ghost train.
problems.answer: Ben — dodgems, Sally — candy floss, Jill — roller coaster, Cody — ghost train

problems.condition: Unit 15, упр. 4, с. 10. Объясни значение выделенных слов по картинкам.
steps: cold — холодно, hot — жарко, hungry — голодный, frightened — напуганный, happy — счастливый, thirsty — хочет пить, sick — тошнит, tired — уставший.
problems.answer: cold, hot, hungry, frightened, happy, thirsty, sick, tired

problems.condition: Unit 15, упр. 5, с. 10. Догадайся, о каком рисунке речь, и заполни пропуски.
steps: A) She is hot. She wants to swim in the river. Picture 2. B) He is hungry. He wants a sandwich. Picture 4. C) She is cold. She wants to put on her coat. Picture 1. D) He is thirsty. He wants some water. Picture 3.

problems.condition: Unit 15, упр. 6, с. 10. Составь диалог.
steps: How do you feel? — I'm cold. What do you want to do? — I want to put on my jacket.
problems.answer: How do you feel? — I'm … What do you want to do? — I want to …

problems.condition: Unit 15, упр. 7, с. 11. Найди слово и транскрипцию; какие согласные обозначены двумя буквами?
steps: thirsty /ˈθɜːsti/ — th; sick /sɪk/ — ck; frightened /ˈfraɪtnd/ — gh (немое).
problems.answer: thirsty, sick; th, ck — один звук

problems.condition: Unit 15, упр. 8, с. 11. Как дети себя чувствуют?
steps: Eddy is hungry. Mary, Cody and Sally are frightened. Sally is sick. Jill is happy. Ben is thirsty.
problems.answer: Eddy — hungry, Mary / Cody / Sally — frightened, Sally — sick, Jill — happy

problems.condition: Unit 15, упр. 9, с. 11. Послушай: о ком говорят? Ответь на вопросы.
steps: Jill, Cody, Ben.

problems.condition: Unit 15, упр. 10, с. 12. Прочитай слова.
steps: Первый столбик — /iː/ (see, tree), второй — /e/ (bed, red), третий — /ɪə/ (here, deer).

problems.condition: Unit 15, упр. 11, с. 12. Составь диалог и опиши животное.
steps: It has got four legs. It is big and fat. What is this animal? — Is it a hippo? — Yes, it is.
problems.answer: It has got … It is … — Is it a …?

problems.condition: Unit 15, упр. 12, с. 12. Разыграй диалог.
steps: How do you feel? — I am cold. Can I have a cup of tea? — Yes, of course.
problems.answer: How do you feel? — I am … Can I have …?

problems.condition: Unit 15, упр. 13, с. 13. Разыграй диалог.
steps: What's this? — It's a roller coaster. Let's go on the roller coaster! — Yes, OK.

problems.condition: Unit 15, упр. 14, с. 13. Послушай песню «В театре».
steps: Песня о театре — волшебном месте, где смех и слёзы меняют настроение.

problems.condition: Unit 15, упр. 15, с. 13. Пригласи друзей в парк аттракционов.
steps: Let's all go on the ghost train! Let's all go on the roller coaster! Let's have some candy floss!

problems.condition: Unit 16, упр. 1, с. 14. Послушай диалог: почему волнуется тётя Бена?
steps: She's late for the train, and Ben's dad can't start the car.
problems.answer: опаздывает на поезд, машина не заводится

problems.condition: Unit 16, упр. 2, с. 15. Прочитай текст и диалог по ролям.
steps: Aunt Kate: I'm late for my train! Dad: The car won't start! Eddy: I'll phone Radio Taxis.

problems.condition: Unit 16, упр. 3, с. 15. Ответь на вопросы по тексту.
steps: Her name is Kate. She is going to France. Her train leaves at quarter past ten. Ben's father can't start the car. Eddy phones Radio Taxis.
problems.answer: Kate; France; quarter past ten; car won't start; Radio Taxis

problems.condition: Unit 16, упр. 4, с. 16. Послушай диалог и спроси друзей о номерах телефонов.
steps: Radio Taxis — 30875. Doctor — 15986. Helen — 22178. Robert — 95822. Station — 65440. School — 36521.

problems.condition: Unit 16, упр. 5, с. 16. Назови виды транспорта и спроси о времени отправления.
steps: What time does the train leave? — At half past nine. What time does the plane leave? — At eleven o'clock. What time does the bus leave? — At half past three. What time does the ship leave? — At two o'clock.
problems.answer: What time does the … leave? — At …

problems.condition: Unit 16, упр. 6, с. 17. Послушай диалог и выбери верный билет.
steps: Билет на самолёт (the plane ticket).

problems.condition: Unit 16, упр. 7, с. 17. Поговори о билетах из упр. 6.
steps: Where is Miss Reed going? — She is going to Edinburgh. Where does she want to go in a taxi? — To the railway station. What time does the train leave? — At half past ten.
problems.answer: Where is … going? What time does the … leave?

problems.condition: Unit 16, упр. 8, с. 17. Составь диалог: звонок в такси.
steps: Woman: Hello, Radio Taxis. Mr Knight: Hello, can I have a taxi, please? Woman: Yes, of course. What's your address? Mr Knight: Number 26, High Road. Woman: Where do you want to go? Mr Knight: To the airport.
problems.answer: Can I have a taxi, please? What's your address? Where do you want to go?

problems.condition: Unit 16, упр. 9, с. 18. Что Даша и Никита берут с собой, а что нет?
steps: Dasha has got her hat and her umbrella. She hasn't got her magazine and her paints. Nikita has got his ball and his T-shirt. He hasn't got his camera.

problems.condition: Unit 16, упр. 10, с. 18. Разыграй диалоги от имени Даши и Никиты.
steps: Nikita: What do you need for your holiday? Dasha: I need my towel and my book. Nikita: Have you got your paints? Dasha: No, I haven't. Nikita: Do you want to take your camera? Dasha: Yes, I do.
problems.answer: What do you need? Have you got …? Do you want to take …?

problems.condition: Unit 16, упр. 11, с. 19. Составь диалог о том, куда вы едете на каникулы.
steps: Where are we going on holiday? — We are going from Russia to China. We can go by train. — I want to go by plane. — OK, let's go by plane.
problems.answer: Where are we going? — We are going to … by …

problems.condition: Unit 16, упр. 12, с. 19. Сделай свой билет и расскажи о нём.
steps: This is my ticket. It's a bus ticket. Where are you going? — I'm going from Kazan to Pskov. What time does the bus leave? — Half past seven. How much is it? — 500 roubles.
problems.answer: This is my ticket. I'm going from … to … The … leaves at …

problems.condition: Unit 16, упр. 13, с. 19. Игра «Я собираюсь на каникулы».
steps: I'm going on holiday and I've got a hat. I'm going on holiday and I've got a hat and a camera. … a hat, a camera and a case…
problems.answer: I'm going on holiday and I've got …

chapters.title: Thank you for your present! Спасибо за подарок

problems.condition: Unit 17, упр. 1, с. 20. Послушай диалог: рад ли Бен посылке?
steps: It's Ben's birthday. The postman brings a parcel. Ben is not very happy — he wanted a plane, but he got a jumper.
problems.answer: Not very — he wanted a plane.

problems.condition: Unit 17, упр. 2, с. 21. Когда у Бена день рождения?
steps: Ben's birthday is on the 8th of May.

problems.condition: Unit 17, упр. 3, с. 21. Прочитай текст упр. 1 в парах.
steps: Mum: Look, Ben. Here's a parcel for you. Ben: Oh! It's from Aunt Kate. Mum: What is it? Ben: It's a jumper…

problems.condition: Unit 17, упр. 4, с. 21. Прочитай письма Бена и покажи посылку, марку, конверт, адреса.
steps: a parcel — посылка, a stamp — марка, an envelope — конверт. Ben's address: 6 Lime Avenue, Newtown. Kate's address: 3 Bristol Street, Bath.

problems.condition: Unit 17, упр. 5, с. 21. Ответь на вопросы к тексту упр. 1.
steps: Yes, I do. No, he doesn't. He really wants a plane.
problems.answer: Yes, I do; No, he doesn't; a plane

problems.condition: Unit 17, упр. 6, с. 22. Послушай и отметь, какие предметы есть у Бена.
steps: a book, a scarf, a jumper, gloves, a pen, a computer.
problems.answer: book, scarf, jumper, gloves, pen, computer

problems.condition: Unit 17, упр. 7, с. 22. Спроси Бена, какие подарки он получил.
steps: What has Ben got for his birthday? — He's got a jumper, a book and gloves, but he wants a plane. What does he want? — A plane and a camera.
problems.answer: What has Ben got? — He's got … but he wants …

problems.condition: Unit 17, упр. 8, с. 22. Что нужно Бену, чтобы написать письмо?
steps: Does Ben need a box? — No. Does he need paints? — No. Does he need pencils? — Yes. Does he need a paint brush? — No. Does he need an envelope? — Yes. Does he need a stamp? — Yes.
problems.answer: needs pencils, paper, an envelope, a stamp

problems.condition: Unit 17, упр. 9, с. 23. Послушай и перечисли названия месяцев.
steps: January, February, March, April, May, June, July, August, September, October, November, December.

problems.condition: Unit 17, упр. 10, с. 23. Обсуди картинки по образцу.
steps: What is the weather like in picture 2? — It's sunny and cold. What can we do in March? — We can play snowballs. What is the weather like in picture 3? — It's warm. What can we do in May? — We can ride a bike.
problems.answer: What is the weather like in …? What can we do in …?

problems.condition: Unit 17, упр. 11, с. 23. Послушай: когда у ребят дни рождения?
steps: Hitesh's birthday is on May 21st. Nicola's birthday is on November 18th. Simon's birthday is on July 7th. Lisa's birthday is on September 14th.
problems.answer: Hitesh — 21 May, Nicola — 18 November, Simon — 7 July, Lisa — 14 September

problems.condition: Unit 17, упр. 12, с. 24. Соотнеси транскрипцию и слова.
steps: first, second, third, fourth, fifth, sixth, seventh, fourteenth, eighteenth, twentieth, twenty-first, twenty-second, thirtieth, thirty-first.

problems.condition: Unit 17, упр. 13, с. 24. Прочитай письма: какие подарки получил Бен?
steps: Letter 1: Dear Maxim, thank you for the spaceship. Letter 2: Dear Grandma, thank you for the book. Letter 3: Dear Aunt Kate, thank you for the jumper.
problems.answer: a spaceship, a book, a jumper

problems.condition: Unit 17, упр. 14, с. 25. Спой песенку: чем она отличается от благодарственного письма?
steps: Песня — письмо тёте Джейн с благодарностью за расчёску, но мальчик хотел машинку. Отличие: в письме не пишут, что хотел другой подарок.
problems.answer: в песне мальчик пишет, что хотел другой подарок

problems.condition: Unit 17, упр. 15, с. 25. Ответь на вопросы.
steps: The boy's name is Joe. His aunt's name is Jane. She gave him a hairbrush. He wants a car.
problems.answer: Joe; Jane; a hairbrush; a car

problems.condition: Unit 17, упр. 16, с. 25. Напиши письмо на основе песенки.
steps: 6 Orange Avenue, Greencity. 11th June. Dear Aunt Jane, thank you for the hairbrush. I think it is very useful. I like hairbrushes, but I like cars too. Love, Joe.
problems.answer: Dear Aunt Jane, thank you for the hairbrush… Love, Joe

problems.condition: Unit 17, упр. 17, с. 25. Расскажи другу о желаемом подарке.
steps: I want a teddy bear. — I don't. I want a doll. I want a train. — I don't. I want chess.
problems.answer: I want a … — I don't. I want a …

problems.condition: Review 3, упр. 1, с. 26. В каких словах ai звучит /eə/, а в каких /eɪ/?
steps: /eə/ air, airport, fair. /eɪ/ afraid, railway, rain, Spain, tail, train.

problems.condition: Review 3, упр. 2, с. 26. Заполни пропуски.
steps: train, bus, plane, ship.

problems.condition: Review 3, упр. 3, с. 26. Реши примеры и назови ответ по-английски.
steps: sixty, ninety-five, fifty-five, eighty-nine, thirty-six, seventy.

problems.condition: Review 3, упр. 4, с. 26. Составь мини-диалоги.
steps: What time does the train for Vologda leave? — At eight o'clock. What time does the train for Saratov leave? — At half past ten. What time does the plane for Sochi leave? — At twelve o'clock.
problems.answer: What time does the train for … leave? — At …

problems.condition: Review 3, упр. 5, с. 26. Дополни предложения просьбой.
steps: I'm thirsty. Can I have a glass of water? I'm hungry. Can I have a sandwich? I'm cold. Can I have a sweater?
problems.answer: Can I have a glass of water / a sandwich / a sweater?

problems.condition: Review 3, упр. 6, с. 27. Какие утверждения верны?
steps: false, false, false, true.

problems.condition: Review 3, упр. 7, с. 27. Перепиши стишок и вставь буквы в дни недели.
steps: Sunday, Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday.

problems.condition: Review 3, упр. 8, с. 27. Назови месяцы по порядку и ответь на вопросы.
steps: January, February, March, April, May, June, July, August, September, October, November, December. My favourite month is December. My birthday is in June.

problems.condition: Unit 18, упр. 1, с. 28. Проследи путь письма от ящика до адресата.
steps: People put letters in the letterbox. The postman takes them to the sorting office. Machines sort the letters and put postmarks. The mail goes to different towns. In the morning postmen deliver the letters.
problems.answer: letterbox → postman → sorting office → postmark → delivery

problems.condition: Unit 18, упр. 2, с. 28. За сколько Королевская почта доставляет письма?
steps: 16 hours.

problems.condition: Unit 18, упр. 3, с. 29. Задай вопросы по действиям на картинках.
steps: What time does the postman put the letters in his sack? What time does the postman go to the sorting office? What time does the machine sort the letters? What time do people get their letters?

problems.condition: Unit 18, упр. 4, с. 30. Определи по часам, что происходит с письмом.
steps: 4:30 — The postman puts the letters in his bag and takes them to the sorting office. 6:00 — The machine sorts letters from parcels. 7:00 — People put letters in letterboxes. 9:00 — The postman delivers the letters.

problems.condition: Unit 18, упр. 5, с. 30. Послушай песню и выпиши этапы пути письма: сколько их?
steps: 7 steps: write, put in the envelope, stamp, letterbox, sorting office, train, postman.

problems.condition: Unit 18, упр. 6, с. 31. Что значит слово sort?
steps: They sort the letters. The letter sorting office. The sorting machine. Слово sort — сортировать, раскладывать по группам.

problems.condition: Unit 18, упр. 7, с. 31. Создай сложные слова.
steps: snowman, postmark, letterbox, postcard, postman.

problems.condition: Unit 18, упр. 8, с. 31. Кто, кому и откуда прислал письма? Когда получил?
steps: Postcard 1: from Aunt Kate to Eddy, from Paris, received on the 11th of May. Postcard 2: from Cody to Ben, from Sydney, received on the 20th of June.

problems.condition: Unit 18, упр. 9, с. 32. Что нужно Лере для электронного письма, а Даше — для бумажного?
steps: Does Lera need a stamp? — No, she doesn't. Does Lera need a computer? — Yes, she does. Does Dasha need a pen? — Yes, she does. Does Dasha need an envelope? — Yes, she does.
problems.answer: Does … need …? — Yes, she does. / No, she doesn't.

problems.condition: Unit 18, упр. 10, с. 32. Прочитай анкету Максима: его распорядок дня.
steps: At 7 o'clock — get up. At 8 o'clock — go to school. At 1.30 — come home. In the evening — watch TV. At 9 o'clock — go to bed.

problems.condition: Unit 18, упр. 11, с. 33. Прочитай правила и сыграй в игру.
steps: 1) Fido gets up at six o'clock. Go to square 3. 4) Sports programme on TV. Miss a turn. 7) Fido goes to the post office. Go to square 10.

chapters.title: What's your favourite lesson? Какой у тебя любимый урок?

problems.condition: Unit 19, упр. 1, с. 34. Во сколько герои приходят в школу? А ты?
steps: Ben and Cody go to school at 9 o'clock. I go to school at half past eight.

problems.condition: Unit 19, упр. 2, с. 34. Прочитай текст в парах.
steps: Ben: I like Wednesdays. We have science in the afternoon. Cody: Is science your favourite lesson? Ben: Yes, it is.
problems.answer: I like Wednesdays. We have science.

problems.condition: Unit 19, упр. 3, с. 35. Послушай и рассмотри картинки: любишь ли ты эти предметы?
steps: Do you like maths? — Yes, I do. Do you like history? — No, I don't. Do you like art? — Yes, I do. Do you like music? — Yes, I do.
problems.answer: Yes, I do. / No, I don't.

problems.condition: Unit 19, упр. 4, с. 35. Прочитай подписи к рисункам и ответь на вопросы.
steps: 9. 4. They are looking at butterflies. 15. She is drawing a dinosaur. They are listening to the teacher.
problems.answer: 9; 4; butterflies; 15; a dinosaur; listening to the teacher

problems.condition: Unit 19, упр. 5, с. 35. Какого слова нет в тексте? Догадайся о значении.
steps: visit — посещение, визит.

problems.condition: Unit 19, упр. 6, с. 36. Выучи названия предметов и разыграй диалог.
steps: swimming — плавание, maths — математика, history — история, art — рисование, music — музыка, science — окружающий мир.
problems.answer: swimming, maths, history, art, music, science

problems.condition: Unit 19, упр. 7, с. 36. Прочитай текст и соедини с картинками.
steps: C, D, A, E, B.

problems.condition: Unit 19, упр. 8, с. 37. Как по-английски «Изобразительное искусство» и «Окружающий мир»?
steps: Art — изобразительное искусство. Science — окружающий мир. Is art your favourite lesson? — Yes, it is. Is science your favourite lesson? — No, it isn't.

problems.condition: Unit 19, упр. 9, с. 37. Поговори о предметах, которые ты изучаешь.
steps: We learn English. — We have English lessons too. We learn physical training. — We have PT too. We learn reading and Russian.

problems.condition: Unit 19, упр. 10, с. 37. Обсуди расписание Никиты.
steps: Nikita arrives at school at 9.00. He has lunch at 12.00. He finishes his lessons at 13.45. He has four lessons every day. On Monday morning he has Russian, maths and reading.
problems.answer: arrives at 9, lunch at 12, finishes at 13:45, 4 lessons a day

problems.condition: Unit 19, упр. 11, с. 38. Разыграй диалог по образцу.
steps: We learn English at school. Do you learn English? — Yes, I like it. We learn art. Do you learn art? — Yes, I like it. We learn Russian. Do you learn Russian? — Yes, I do.
problems.answer: We learn … Do you learn …? — Yes, I like it.

problems.condition: Unit 19, упр. 12, с. 38. Расставь пропущенные буквы в словах.
steps: where, castle, what, listen, wheel, science, answer.
